cohesionFirstPrinciples.label: Full-source concept first
cohesionFirstPrinciples.evidence: Approve the creature only after the intact source image reads as one coherent animal or organism before any limbs, parts, or animation frames are extracted.

cohesionFirstPrinciples.label: Mechanical rig preview is not art approval
cohesionFirstPrinciples.evidence: A sandbox screenshot, contact sheet, or working articulation proves technical readiness only; it cannot rescue source art that lacks a unified silhouette, anatomy, palette, and material language.

cohesionFirstPrinciples.label: Reject placeholder cohesion
cohesionFirstPrinciples.evidence: If the design reads as placeholder parts, unrelated pasted fragments, or a proof-of-concept assembly, reject it for regeneration rather than promoting it into the 20-threat gate.

requiredCohesionChecks.label: Whole creature cohesion
requiredCohesionChecks.evidence: The image reads as one designed organism, not a bundle of unrelated shapes.

requiredCohesionChecks.label: Part continuity cohesion
requiredCohesionChecks.evidence: Limbs, joints, materials, lighting, and proportions remain continuous across riggable parts.

requiredCohesionChecks.label: Readable silhouette
requiredCohesionChecks.evidence: The creature is identifiable at gameplay scale and has a clear attack profile.

requiredCohesionChecks.label: No collage artifacts
requiredCohesionChecks.evidence: No pasted, mismatched, duplicate, or style-inconsistent fragments are visible.

requiredCohesionChecks.label: Non-placeholder art direction
requiredCohesionChecks.evidence: The art looks like production source material, not a temporary technical prototype.

requiredCohesionChecks.label: Clean magenta key
requiredCohesionChecks.evidence: The pure magenta background can be removed without white/dark halos or lost anatomy.

requiredCohesionChecks.label: Neutral riggable pose
requiredCohesionChecks.evidence: The pose exposes pivots, attack parts, and crop-safe margins for articulation.
